flags.why: The example uses sóng triều for the daily tidal cycle, whereas it denotes waves produced by the rising tide ([definition](https://www.banthedaohaingoai.org/PostedInfo.aspx?CategoryID=18&PostID=579&second=44)).
flags.fix: Sóng triều cuồn cuộn đổ vào cửa sông. = Tidal waves surged into the river mouth.

flags.why: This regional term is used mainly in Southern Vietnamese but lacks a Southern tag ([dictionary](https://loigiaihay.com/tu-dien-tv/sung-sau-edrsPw7eMILLd.html)).
The archaic meaning refers generally to plants or wood, rather than a particular kind of tree ([dictionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/s%C4%83ng)).
